name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated general contractor for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of hiring an owner-operated general contractor for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with a hands-on general contractor gives you a single point of contact who leads site framing, drywall, and finish carpentry while directly coordinating specialized plumbing and electrical sub-trades. This integrated oversight helps keep structural modifications, trade sequencing, and custom installations on schedule. In contrast, self-managing individual trade subcontractors puts the burden of scheduling, code compliance, framing verification, and finish alignment entirely on the homeowner. Single-lead coordination reduces miscommunication between mechanical rough-ins and cabinet installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: An owner-operated general contractor personally manages the work site, schedules sub-trades, and ensures framing, drywall, and tile fit together smoothly under one point of contact.
